name: PackhouseLotTraceability
tagline: Field / block to pallet and shipment – one-up / one-down trace, holds and mock recalls in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete traceability app for fruit and vegetable packhouses: harvest lots from grower blocks, grading and pack-out with mass balance, palletising with GS1 SSCCs and a PTI-style voice pick code, loads built from pallets, holds that block everything downstream, key data elements per critical tracking event and timed mock recall drills that list the customers to notify. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Genealogy from one Source lots column – trace any lot back to the field / block and forward to every customer
Grade / pack out, palletise, load and merge dialogs with mass-balance tolerance and pack-out loss allowance
Holds propagate downstream; blocked lots cannot ship, release refused while a source is held
Key data elements checked per event (harvest, pack, palletise, ship); require KDEs to ship
Mock recall: full scope or forward only, drill timer vs target, % accounted, customers to notify, real hold / recall actions
GS1 SSCC with check digit, next-SSCC generator, printable pallet tag with GTIN and voice pick code
Drag-and-drop packhouse flow board, bulk hold / release / merge / ship, CSV exports
Power Fx outputs (TraceJson, RecallJson, PalletTagJson, NewRecordsJson, KPIs) and OnCreate / OnSave / OnStatusChange / OnAction events
Demo mode with a fictional apple and pear packhouse; phone, tablet and desktop layouts
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard (Power Pages field control PackhouseLotTraceabilityPortal)
